sources.snippet: Pauper Llama 3 8B: Specialized MTG Pauper AI This model, developed by nmalinowski, is a fine-tuned version of Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct specifically designed for Magic: The Gathering's Pauper format. Utilizing LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) fine-tuning, it has been optimized to provide in-depth knowledge and generate relevant content about Pauper.
